content.title: About
content.content: Ham and vegetables is a ready‑to‑eat mix that includes tender boiled ham, carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens (spinach, kale). The product contains no potatoes and no sauce, making it a convenient light lunch or dinner option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Traditional ham is made from pork, but the mix uses a lean cut with minimal fat.
Broccoli is rich in vitamin C and phytochemicals that support detoxification.
Carrots are one of the richest sources of beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
Dark‑green leafy vegetables contain chlorophyll and high amounts of vitamin K.
The mix is vacuum‑packed, keeping the vegetables fresh for up to 7 days.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Ham provides complete animal protein essential for muscle repair and growth.

items.title: Vision support
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots is converted to vitamin A, promoting healthy eyesight.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin C from broccoli and chlorophyll from leafy greens help combat free radicals.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Vitamin K and calcium in leafy greens contribute to bone mineralization.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Fiber from carrots and broccoli supports regular bowel function.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ham can be salty; people monitoring sodium intake should watch portion size.

items.title: Pork allergy
items.content: Some individuals may have an allergic reaction to pork.

items.title: Possible preservatives
items.content: Ham sometimes contains nitrites; choose nitrate‑free versions when possible.

items.title: Food interactions
items.content: High vitamin K levels can affect the efficacy of anticoagulant medications.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The mix is ready to eat straight from the package. Slice the ham, eat the vegetables as is, add them to a salad, or gently steam them for a warm dish.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. After opening, consume within 3‑4 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
